decision.hypothesis: Moving south onto the junction and then east along the cobblestones will lead across the river toward the Fish Shop and beach.
decision.memory: Objective: meet Willy at the beach south of Pelican Town. Stay on cobblestones at the southern junction; avoid the grass below the road and the wooded southern exit.
